todo.name: Fix OUTNQ canonical naming regression
todo.description: `extract_outnq_summary()` currently returns `outflow_max_q` while the test suite expects canonical `q_max`; align constants, extractor output, and downstream consumers so `tests/unit/test_outnq_extraction.py` passes again.

todo.name: Fix ARF.DAT loading in model merge pipeline
todo.description: `core.model_data_extraction.extract_model_data_to_df()` passes the project directory to `extract_arf_dat()`, which expects a file path and currently raises a permission error; normalize the contract so ARF attributes and rasters are actually produced.

todo.name: Stabilize merged model dataframe assembly
todo.description: `extract_model_data_to_df()` merges `SUPER.OUT` inside `controlled_merge()` and then merges it again, creating duplicated `*_x` and `*_y` columns; remove double-merges, add explicit required-file validation, and fail cleanly when `DEPTH.OUT` is absent.

todo.name: Correct MANNINGS_N.DAT parsing
todo.description: `extract_mannings_n_dat()` reads `MANNINGS_N.DAT` with a two-column schema even though the fixture data is grid/x/y/n style; fix the parser so grid IDs and Manning values are mapped correctly.

todo.name: Repair pytest configuration
todo.description: `pytest.ini` uses `[tool:pytest]` instead of `[pytest]`, so custom marks are not registered and the suite emits unknown-mark warnings; fix the config and keep coverage options under the correct section.

todo.name: Unify extractor interfaces and logging
todo.description: Standardize extractors to accept either project folders or explicit file paths consistently, replace remaining ad-hoc `print()` calls, and merge the duplicated logger and `TimingLogger` implementations so repeated setup does not accumulate handlers.

todo.name: Create a single supported-file registry
todo.description: Supported filenames are split across `main.py`, `core/file_discovery.py`, and `core/model_data_extraction.py`, which causes drift for files like `HYDROSTRUCT.OUT` and partial `LEVEE.DAT` support; centralize this metadata and drive discovery, orchestration, and UI from one source.

todo.name: Add regression tests for merge and orchestration bugs
todo.description: Add targeted tests for ARF loading, MANNINGS parsing, OUTNQ canonical columns, duplicate SUPER merges, and missing-core-file behavior so the current regressions do not recur.

todo.name: Expand parser coverage for under-tested modules
todo.description: Add unit tests for currently under-covered extractors and report builders, especially `fpxsec`, `hystruc`, `swmmflort`, `topo`, `mannings_n`, `finaldep`, `finalvel`, `timeoneft`, `timetwoft`, `timetopeak`, `velfp`, and `infil_depth`.

todo.name: Add CONT.DAT and TOLER.DAT post-processing
todo.description: Implement `CONT.DAT` and `TOLER.DAT` parsing and surface their switches and parameters in outputs; these files are present in all sampled models and should drive conditional validation for channel, street, levee, SWMM, rain, infiltration, and hydraulic-structure workflows.

todo.name: Complete LEVEE.DAT workflow support
todo.description: `LEVEE.DAT` already has a parser, but it is not wired into discovery, main processing, tests, or outputs; finish the integration and add post-processing for companion outputs such as `LEVEEDEFIC.OUT` and `LEVOVERTOPMAX.OUT`.

todo.name: Surface section and profile outputs
todo.description: Promote the existing `CHANWS.OUT` and `HYCHAN.OUT` profile work and extend section reporting to model files seen in the sample projects such as `CROSSMAX.OUT`, `CROSSQ.OUT`, `CHANNEL_CONVERGENCE.OUT`, `CHVOLUME.OUT`, and `OVERBANK.OUT`.

todo.name: Add storm-drain companion file support
todo.description: Detroit Basin includes `SWMMFLO.DAT`, `SWMMOUTF.DAT`, `SWMMOUTFIN.OUT`, `ManholePop.OUT`, and related storm-drain diagnostics; add parsers, geometry and report outputs, and optional `SDCLOGGING.DAT` support to round out the SWMM workflow around the already-supported `SWMM.inp` and `SWMMFLORT.DAT`.

todo.name: Add optional roughness and stability override inputs
todo.description: Implement documented optional inputs `FPFROUDE.DAT`, `SHALLOWN_SPATIAL.DAT`, and `TOLSPATIAL.DAT`, and link them to raster and vector outputs so users can inspect spatial overrides to global control values.

todo.name: Add STREET.DAT support
todo.description: Implement `STREET.DAT` parsing, validation, and geometry and report outputs so street-routing models can be post-processed when `MSTREET = 1` in `CONT.DAT`.

todo.name: Broaden gridded OUT-file post-processing
todo.description: Add a generic raster and vector pipeline for additional gridded outputs already present in the real models, including `FINALDIR.OUT`, `VELDIREC.OUT`, `DEPFP.OUT`, `DEPTHTOL.OUT`, `IMPACT.OUT`, `FLOODWAVETIME.OUT`, `FLOODWAY.OUT`, `SURFAREA.OUT`, `SPECENERGY.OUT`, `STATICPRESS.OUT`, `FPINFILTRATION.OUT`, `INFILHY.OUT`, `INTERGWS.OUT`, and `ROUGH.OUT`.
